candidates.doc:
buildGrantKeywordPlusDynamicPTEffect implements the
grant_keyword_plus_dynamic_pt_until_eot primitive (ticket
engine.auto-grant-keyword-plus-dynamic-pt-until-eot-bdb265d199, Skittering
Cicada class): "Whenever you cast a colorless spell, until end of turn,
this creature gains trample and gets +X/+X, where X is that spell's mana
value." Distinct from grant_keyword_eot (keyword only, no P/T) and the
existing power_from=referent_spell_mana_value pump (asymmetric +X/+0, no
keyword): the keyword and a SYMMETRIC +X/+X ride together on ONE
ContinuousEffect so both expire together at end of turn. X reuses the
same event_subject_mana_value dynamic-amount spec already evaluated by
EvalDynamicAmountFull elsewhere, resolved fresh on every call so repeated
triggers each get their own independent effect instead of overwriting a
shared one (0 is a legal resolved amount and still yields a grant, just
with a +0/+0 bonus).

candidates.title: buildGrantKeywordPlusDynamicPTEffect

candidates.doc:
PowerToughnessUnequal implements the power_toughness_inequality_filter
permanent-filter bucket primitive (ticket
engine.auto-power-toughness-inequality-filter-f31bdd4048, Gilt-Leaf
Winnower class): "destroy target ... creature whose power and toughness
aren't equal." Matches a permanent only when its CURRENT power differs
from its CURRENT toughness. Read straight off Card.BasePower/
BaseToughness rather than any printed/characteristic-defining snapshot —
every P/T modifier this engine applies (CdaPTSpec recomputes, EOT
pump/shrink effects) writes directly into these two fields, so they
already reflect continuous effects at read time. Symmetric +1/+1 or
-1/-1 counters need no special handling here: they add the same delta to
both sides, so they can never flip an equal P/T into an unequal one or
vice versa — only an asymmetric modifier (e.g. a 4/4 pumped to 5/3) can.
Non-creatures (nil BasePower/BaseToughness) never match.
candidates.name: PowerToughnessUnequal
candidates.title: PowerToughnessUnequal
